rationale: The agent executed the exchange immediately (“Your exchange is officially in motion!”) without first authenticating the user or confirming the order-changing action, both required by policy. There is no evidence of user authentication beyond the user-provided email, nor confirmation prior to performing the write. The agent also stated a specific refund amount ($7.99) and follow-up steps without clearly supported tool results in the conversation. Even if back-end tools were invoked, the lack of explicit confirmation before the write and missing authentication step mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
